certificate.description: PacketLight's PL-2000GA and PL-2000GM Layer-1 encryption solutions with comprehensive line and service performance monitoring, ensure the confidentiality and integrity of data, based on GCM-AES-256 encryption standards, supporting Diffie-Hellman (DH) key exchange up to every 1-minute. In addition, the solutions support multiple protocols including 10G/40G/100G Ethernet, 16G Fibre Channel, OTU2/OTU2e/OTU4.
